author: Catverter
description: English localization for Catverter Core Mass.

en.description: Funny mass units and the default variant definitions.

kitten.name: Kitten
kitten.description: A tiny warm-up unit for suspiciously small weights.
kitten.scientificNote: Specimens should be weighed before discovering the food bowl.

skinny-cat.name: Skinny cat
skinny-cat.description: The streamlined feline. Mostly opinions and bones.
skinny-cat.scientificNote: Measurements exclude dramatic complaints about underfeeding.
skinny-cat.origin: Institute of Feline Metrology field notes

standard-cat.name: Standard cat
standard-cat.description: The benchmark feline. Usually judging you.
standard-cat.scientificNote: All Standard Cats are calibrated annually by the Quality Assurance Department.

old-cat.name: Old cat
old-cat.description: A senior cat with excellent nap credentials.
old-cat.scientificNote: Approved only when the subject has earned at least one favorite blanket.

angry-cat.name: Angry cat
angry-cat.scientificNote: Mass may appear larger while the unit is staring directly at you.

fat-cat.name: Fat cat
fat-cat.scientificNote: Dinner status must be recorded before calibration.

maine-coon.name: Maine Coon
maine-coon.description: A large-cat unit for premium fluff density.
maine-coon.scientificNote: Includes an estimated fluff correction factor of yes.

golden-retriever.name: Golden retriever
golden-retriever.description: Useful when the answer needs friendly dog energy.

bowling-ball.name: Bowling ball
bowling-ball.scientificNote: Not approved for rolling down stairs during experiments.

average-chair.name: Average chair
average-chair.description: Please do not sit on fractional chairs.

microwave-oven.name: Microwave oven
microwave-oven.description: Kitchen appliance mass, because why not.

banana.name: Banana
banana.scientificNote: Curvature not included in mass calculation.

potato.name: Potato
potato.description: The dependable unit of pantry science.
potato.scientificNote: Subject may sprout if validation is delayed.

pizza.name: Pizza
pizza.description: A dinner-sized disc of approximate truth.

lego-brick.name: LEGO brick
lego-brick.scientificNote: Pain index intentionally omitted from SI conversion.

honey-bee.name: Honey bee
honey-bee.scientificNote: Counting protocol requires patience and unreasonable confidence.

blue-whale.name: Blue whale
blue-whale.description: For when the numbers should get wonderfully tiny.

t-rex.name: T. rex
t-rex.description: Large, extinct, and hard to fit in a kitchen.
t-rex.scientificNote: All values reconstructed from fossil bureaucracy.

loaf-cat.name: Loaf cat
loaf-cat.description: A cat in its aerodynamically optimized resting configuration.
loaf-cat.scientificNote: Paw visibility immediately invalidates the measurement.

sleepy-cat.name: Sleepy cat
sleepy-cat.description: A feline observed during one of its scheduled eighteen daily naps.
sleepy-cat.scientificNote: Measurements taken only while snoring softly.

zooming-cat.name: Zooming cats
zooming-cat.description: A high-velocity cat usually encountered at 3:17 AM.
zooming-cat.scientificNote: Specimens exceeding Mach 1 should not be pursued.

chihuahua.name: Chihuahua
chihuahua.description: A compact canine convinced it outweighs everything else.

labrador.name: Labrador
labrador.description: An excessively enthusiastic dog with questionable personal boundaries.
labrador.scientificNote: Keeping the specimen still remains an unsolved engineering problem.

happy-cow.name: Happy cow
happy-cow.description: A content grazing specimen with above-average moo quality.
happy-cow.scientificNote: Measurements should be performed after unrestricted access to grass.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep.description: A fluffy unit primarily used in counting and accidental roadblocks.
sheep.scientificNote: Fluff contributes approximately 98% of perceived volume.

rubber-duck.name: Rubber duck
rubber-duck.scientificNote: Certified listener. Advice quality not guaranteed.

mechanical-keyboard.name: Mechanical keyboard
mechanical-keyboard.description: Preferred by software developers and office noise complaints alike.
mechanical-keyboard.scientificNote: Clickiness does not affect measured mass.

refrigerator.name: Refrigerator
refrigerator.scientificNote: Measurements exclude mysterious leftovers older than six months.

croissant.name: Croissant
croissant.description: A buttery unit with disappointing structural integrity.

parmesan-wheel.name: Parmesan wheel
parmesan-wheel.description: An Italian-approved large culinary reference unit.
parmesan-wheel.scientificNote: Scientific tasting performed after every calibration.
parmesan-wheel.origin: Consortium of Extremely Serious Cheese Scientists

skinny.descriptionPattern: A slimmer variant of {singular}, calibrated for suspiciously narrow interpretations.

tall.descriptionPattern: A vertically ambitious variant of {singular} with extra measurement confidence.

happy.descriptionPattern: A cheerful variant of {singular}; the unit appears more cooperative than usual.

sad.descriptionPattern: A melancholic variant of {singular}, suitable for emotionally damp measurements.
sad.scientificNotePattern: {scientificNote} Mood variant: nominal conversion unchanged, morale reduced.
